text:
The council requests its envoy to convene representatives for negotiations. This fictional request does not establish that talks have taken place.

A separate fictional report states that a preparatory meeting was held on 12 March 2024. Its participant list and independent corroboration are not supplied.

An analyst proposes comparing participation, agreed procedures and follow-up evidence before assessing whether the political process is inclusive.

The fictional source adds that the reported attendance is provisional and has not been independently checked. This qualification limits any assessment of participation.

annotations.qualification: No meeting or implementation is established by the request.
